messages:
Megan (CS): Heads-up — Nexon account: onboarding metrics show a steady ~18% drop in successful completions for their support-bot flow over the last 48h. Renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks; want to preempt quality concerns. My proposal: proactively run a small canary that swaps non-critical routes to a compact quantized model and add a routing rule to keep high-priority traffic on current model. Thoughts? :eyes:
AJ (Eng): Got the telemetry. We saw p95 latency spikes coinciding with token bursts — cost per request up ~22%. Quick snapshot:
```
p50: 210ms
p95: 720ms
avg_tokens: 450
cost_delta: +22%
error_rate: +0.9%
```
AJ (Eng): Routing idea: route requests with "high_confidence" tag to dedicated pool (current model), everything else to compact. That keeps SLA for critical flows.
Sasha (ML): Quick eval note — int8 on rdx-compact-v1 drops Rouge by ~0.8% on our Nexon prompt set, BLEU similar. Tradeoff looks acceptable for peripheral routes but not for support escalations. Recommend: 1) Canary 5% traffic, 48h; 2) Eval hooks that run nightly on sampled requests; 3) Prefix caching for repeated prompts.
deploy-bot: Canary config staged:
```
canary:
  model: rdx-compact-v1-int8
  traffic: 5%
  duration: 48h
  eval_hook: nexon_nightly_eval_v2
  fallback: immediate
```
Megan (CS): Great. I'll book a 30m enablement call with Nexon to explain minimal user-facing change and the rollback plan. Can someone draft a 2-sentence blurb I can send to the customer? :rocket:
AJ (Eng): Draft blurb below — feel free to copy: 
"Hi Nexon team — we're running a short A/B test on lower-cost inference for non-critical flows to reduce latency variability and cost. No action required; we will monitor accuracy closely and revert if we see regression beyond agreed thresholds."
Sasha (ML): Add gating rule suggestion: if nightly_eval.rouge_drop > 1.2% OR error_rate increases >0.5% for 3 consecutive checks -> auto rollback and alert #customer-success. Also capture qualitative feedback via short post-test survey for any escalations.
Megan (CS): Assigning owners: @Sasha owns eval gating and dataset, @AJ owns routing config & canary rollout, I’ll handle customer comms and renewal notes. I'll add a row in the renewal tracker noting this mitigation step.
deploy-bot: Canary live in us-west-2 on 5% traffic. Dashboards: https://dash.internal/redwood/nexon/canary (internal)
Megan (CS): Action items: 1) Sasha: push nightly eval and set gating alarms; 2) AJ: ensure routing rule excludes "escalation" tag; 3) Me: send blurb + schedule enablement call for tomorrow. I'll log outcome in Salesforce renewal task. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
